decisions.reason: As a newly launched dental consumable with its own webpage, it reflects visible commitment and a modest investment that management is likely to defend for at least another year.

This thermoforming blank fits the firm’s dental materials base and, given the dedicated presentation and recent launch, disappointing early traction would likely be treated as temporary rather than grounds for withdrawal.

Because it was only mentioned rather than strongly featured, management has less public commitment to justify here, but the product is still close enough to the established dental workflow business to retain for now.
The intraoral contrast spray is visibly backed on its own page and supports the firm’s stated move toward digital workflows, which makes management especially inclined to continue with it.
Even with limited website prominence, a custom earmold line is highly consistent with the firm’s custom-device capabilities and hearing-care customer base, encouraging persistence after launch.

Custom hearing protection earmolds are strategically adjacent to the firm’s hearing business and likely benefit from sunk development and channel commitments, though the lower visibility makes them somewhat easier to prune than the most featured launches.
